# Global Food Waste Supply Chain Analysis

## Overview
This dataset collection characterizes food waste across the global supply chain — from production through consumption — quantifying waste shares, associated greenhouse gas emissions, avoidable waste proportions, and intervention potential across five world regions.

## Data Source

### waste_by_stage_and_region
Contains 24 rows covering 6 region groups (including Global Average) × 4 supply chain stages. Fields: `region` (string), `stage` (categorical: Production, Processing, Retail, Consumption), `waste_pct` (numeric, percent of total food waste within that region, sums to 100 per region).

### carbon_emissions_by_stage
Contains 4 rows, one per supply chain stage. Fields: `stage` (categorical), `emission_pct` (numeric, percent of total food-waste emissions, sums to 100), `emission_mt_co2e` (numeric, absolute emissions in megatonnes CO2 equivalent). Total global food-waste emissions approximately 4,500 Mt CO2e.

### avoidable_waste_by_stage
Contains 24 rows (6 regions × 4 stages). Fields: `region` (string), `stage` (categorical), `avoidable_pct` (numeric, 0–100, proportion of that stage's waste deemed avoidable).

### intervention_impact_potential
Contains 4 rows. Fields: `stage` (categorical), `food_saveable_mt` (numeric, megatonnes of food potentially saved), `co2_avoidable_mt` (numeric, megatonnes CO2e avoidable), `key_interventions` (string, summary of primary intervention types).

## Data Notes
- Estimates are synthesized from FAO and UNEP 2021–2023 reports with regional adjustments.
- Avoidable waste percentages reflect technical feasibility, not economic viability.
- Carbon emission figures include embedded agricultural, transport, and disposal emissions.

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.gridspec as gridspec
import numpy as np

# --- Data ---
regions_ordered = ["Sub-Saharan Africa", "South & Southeast Asia", "Latin America", "Europe", "North America & Oceania"]
stages = ["Production", "Processing", "Retail", "Consumption"]

waste = {
    "North America & Oceania": [12.0, 8.5, 11.0, 68.5],
    "Europe": [14.0, 10.0, 12.5, 63.5],
    "Sub-Saharan Africa": [39.0, 28.0, 19.0, 14.0],
    "South & Southeast Asia": [32.0, 24.0, 18.0, 26.0],
    "Latin America": [28.0, 19.0, 17.0, 36.0],
    "Global Average": [24.0, 18.0, 15.0, 43.0],
}

carbon = {"Production": 30.5, "Processing": 22.0, "Retail": 16.5, "Consumption": 31.0}
global_waste = {"Production": 24.0, "Processing": 18.0, "Retail": 15.0, "Consumption": 43.0}

avoidable = {
    "North America & Oceania": [55, 70, 78, 62],
    "Europe": [58, 72, 80, 65],
    "Sub-Saharan Africa": [75, 68, 50, 30],
    "South & Southeast Asia": [72, 65, 52, 40],
    "Latin America": [68, 60, 58, 48],
    "Global Average": [65, 67, 64, 52],
}

intervention = {
    "Production": {"food": 210, "co2": 890},
    "Processing": {"food": 155, "co2": 665},
    "Retail": {"food": 120, "co2": 475},
    "Consumption": {"food": 280, "co2": 725},
}

# --- Colors ---
stage_colors = ["#2C5F2D", "#6B8F71", "#C2956E", "#D4443B"]
region_short = {"Sub-Saharan Africa": "Sub-Saharan\nAfrica", "South & Southeast Asia": "S & SE\nAsia",
                "Latin America": "Latin\nAmerica", "Europe": "Europe", "North America & Oceania": "N America\n& Oceania"}

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(20, 22), facecolor='white')
gs = gridspec.GridSpec(3, 2, hspace=0.38, wspace=0.30, left=0.07, right=0.95, top=0.93, bottom=0.04)

fig.suptitle("Global Food Waste Across the Supply Chain:\nWaste Flows, Carbon Impact & Intervention Priorities",
             fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=0.97, color='#222222', fontstyle='normal')

# --- Panel A: Stacked bar – waste by region ---
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
x = np.arange(len(regions_ordered))
bottoms = np.zeros(len(regions_ordered))
for i, st in enumerate(stages):
    vals = [waste[r][i] for r in regions_ordered]
    ax1.bar(x, vals, bottom=bottoms, color=stage_colors[i], label=st, width=0.6, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)
    for j, v in enumerate(vals):
        if v > 6:
            ax1.text(x[j], bottoms[j] + v/2, f"{v:.0f}%", ha='center', va='center', fontsize=8, color='white', fontweight='bold')
    bottoms += vals
ax1.set_xticks(x)
ax1.set_xticklabels([region_short[r] for r in regions_ordered], fontsize=8.5)
ax1.set_ylabel("Share of Total Food Waste (%)", fontsize=10)
ax1.set_title("A. Waste Distribution by Supply Chain Stage & Region", fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax1.legend(fontsize=8.5, loc='upper right', framealpha=0.9)
ax1.set_ylim(0, 108)
ax1.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax1.spines['right'].set_visible(False)

# --- Panel B: Paired bars – waste vs carbon (global) ---
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
x2 = np.arange(len(stages))
w = 0.32
waste_vals = [global_waste[s] for s in stages]
carbon_vals = [carbon[s] for s in stages]
bars1 = ax2.bar(x2 - w/2, waste_vals, w, color='#6B8F71', label='Waste Share (%)', edgecolor='white')
bars2 = ax2.bar(x2 + w/2, carbon_vals, w, color='#D4443B', label='Carbon Share (%)', edgecolor='white')
for b in bars1:
    ax2.text(b.get_x() + b.get_width()/2, b.get_height() + 0.8, f"{b.get_height():.1f}", ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=8.5, color='#2C5F2D')
for b in bars2:
    ax2.text(b.get_x() + b.get_width()/2, b.get_height() + 0.8, f"{b.get_height():.1f}", ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=8.5, color='#D4443B')
# Highlight disproportionate stages
for i, s in enumerate(stages):
    ratio = carbon_vals[i] / waste_vals[i]
    if ratio > 1.1:
        ax2.annotate(f"Carbon\nintensity\n{ratio:.1f}×", xy=(x2[i]+w/2, carbon_vals[i]),
                     xytext=(x2[i]+0.55, carbon_vals[i]+5), fontsize=7.5, color='#D4443B',
                     fontweight='bold', ha='center',
                     arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#D4443B', lw=1.2))
ax2.set_xticks(x2)
ax2.set_xticklabels(stages, fontsize=9.5)
ax2.set_ylabel("Share of Total (%)", fontsize=10)
ax2.set_title("B. Waste Share vs Carbon Emission Share (Global)", fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax2.legend(fontsize=9, loc='upper left', framealpha=0.9)
ax2.set_ylim(0, 52)
ax2.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax2.spines['right'].set_visible(False)

# --- Panel C: Heatmap – avoidable waste by region & stage ---
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
regions_heat = regions_ordered + ["Global Average"]
heat_data = np.array([avoidable[r] for r in regions_heat])
im = ax3.imshow(heat_data, cmap='YlOrRd', aspect='auto', vmin=25, vmax=85)
ax3.set_xticks(range(len(stages)))
ax3.set_xticklabels(stages, fontsize=9.5)
ax3.set_yticks(range(len(regions_heat)))
region_heat_labels = [region_short.get(r, r) for r in regions_heat]
region_heat_labels[-1] = "Global\nAverage"
ax3.set_yticklabels(region_heat_labels, fontsize=8.5)
for i in range(len(regions_heat)):
    for j in range(len(stages)):
        color = 'white' if heat_data[i, j] > 65 else '#333333'
        ax3.text(j, i, f"{heat_data[i,j]:.0f}%", ha='center', va='center', fontsize=9.5, fontweight='bold', color=color)
cbar = plt.colorbar(im, ax=ax3, fraction=0.046, pad=0.04)
cbar.set_label("Avoidable Waste (%)", fontsize=9)
ax3.set_title("C. Avoidable Waste Proportion by Stage & Region", fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', pad=10)

# --- Panel D: Bubble chart – intervention priority (avoidable waste × carbon × food saveable) ---
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
global_avoid = [avoidable["Global Average"][i] for i in range(4)]
carbon_pcts = [carbon[s] for s in stages]
food_save = [intervention[s]["food"] for s in stages]
co2_save = [intervention[s]["co2"] for s in stages]

for i, s in enumerate(stages):
    size = food_save[i] * 2.5
    ax4.scatter(global_avoid[i], carbon_pcts[i], s=size, c=stage_colors[i], alpha=0.8,
                edgecolors='#333', linewidth=1.2, zorder=3)
    ax4.annotate(f"{s}\n({food_save[i]} Mt food\n{co2_save[i]} Mt CO₂e)",
                 xy=(global_avoid[i], carbon_pcts[i]),
                 xytext=(8, 8), textcoords='offset points', fontsize=8, fontweight='bold',
                 color=stage_colors[i])

ax4.set_xlabel("Avoidable Waste (% of stage waste)", fontsize=10)
ax4.set_ylabel("Carbon Emission Share (%)", fontsize=10)
ax4.set_title("D. Intervention Priority: Avoidable Waste × Carbon Impact", fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax4.set_xlim(48, 72)
ax4.set_ylim(13, 36)
ax4.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax4.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
# Priority zone
ax4.axhspan(25, 36, xmin=0.55, alpha=0.08, color='#D4443B', zorder=1)
ax4.text(68, 35, "HIGH\nPRIORITY", fontsize=9, color='#D4443B', fontweight='bold', ha='center', va='top', alpha=0.6)

# size legend
for sz, label in [(120*2.5, "120 Mt"), (280*2.5, "280 Mt")]:
    ax4.scatter([], [], s=sz, c='gray', alpha=0.5, edgecolors='#333', linewidth=1, label=f"Food saveable: {label}")
ax4.legend(fontsize=8, loc='lower left', framealpha=0.9, title="Bubble size", title_fontsize=8)

# --- Panel E: Regional shift summary – grouped horizontal bars showing top waste stage per region ---
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, :])
# Show avoidable waste (absolute: waste_pct * avoidable_pct / 100) stacked by stage for each region
regions_e = regions_ordered
y_pos = np.arange(len(regions_e))
bar_h = 0.18
for i, st in enumerate(stages):
    total_waste = [waste[r][i] for r in regions_e]
    avoid_waste = [waste[r][i] * avoidable[r][i] / 100 for r in regions_e]
    unavoid = [total_waste[j] - avoid_waste[j] for j in range(len(regions_e))]
    # Avoidable portion (solid)
    ax5.barh(y_pos + i*bar_h - 0.27, avoid_waste, bar_h*0.9, color=stage_colors[i], alpha=0.95,
             label=f"{st} – avoidable" if True else "", edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)
    # Unavoidable portion (hatched)
    ax5.barh(y_pos + i*bar_h - 0.27, unavoid, bar_h*0.9, left=avoid_waste,
             color=stage_colors[i], alpha=0.3, edgecolor=stage_colors[i], linewidth=0.5, hatch='///')

for j, r in enumerate(regions_e):
    # Find highest avoidable absolute waste
    abs_avoid = [waste[r][i] * avoidable[r][i] / 100 for i in range(4)]
    max_idx = np.argmax(abs_avoid)
    total_for_max = waste[r][max_idx]
    ax5.annotate("★", xy=(total_for_max + 0.3, y_pos[j] + max_idx*bar_h - 0.27),
                 fontsize=11, color='#D4443B', fontweight='bold', va='center')

ax5.set_yticks(y_pos)
ax5.set_yticklabels([region_short[r] for r in regions_e], fontsize=9)
ax5.set_xlabel("Share of Total Food Waste (%)", fontsize=10)
ax5.set_title("E. Intervention Hotspots: Avoidable (solid) vs Unavoidable (hatched) Waste by Stage & Region  (★ = top priority stage)",
              fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax5.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax5.spines['right'].set_visible(False)

# Custom legend for panel E
from matplotlib.patches import Patch
legend_elements = [Patch(facecolor=stage_colors[i], label=stages[i]) for i in range(4)]
legend_elements += [Patch(facecolor='gray', alpha=0.9, label='Avoidable'),
                    Patch(facecolor='gray', alpha=0.3, hatch='///', edgecolor='gray', label='Unavoidable')]
ax5.legend(handles=legend_elements, fontsize=8, loc='lower right', ncol=3, framealpha=0.9)

# Source note
fig.text(0.07, 0.005, "Data: FAO & UNEP 2021–2023 estimates  |  Carbon figures include embedded agricultural, transport & disposal emissions",
         fontsize=8, color='#666666', fontstyle='italic')

plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=180, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white')
print("Done")
